name: Vector Symbolic Architecture (VSA) family
description: Family of architectures using high-dimensional vectors for symbolic computation: HRR (Plate 1995) -> FHRR (Plate 2003 complex phasor) -> GHRR (Schlegel 2024 noncommutative matrix) + TPR (Smolensky 1990) + BSC (Kanerva 1996 binary). All use bind/unbind/cleanup primitives over high-D space. Substrate is VSA family member.

name: Hopfield-style associative memory family
description: Family of recurrent neural network associative memories: classical Hopfield (1982) -> AGS capacity (1985 0.138 N) -> modern Hopfield (Ramsauer 2020 exponential capacity + attention bridge). Substrate cleanup retrieval = Hopfield-style pattern completion at high-D.

name: Cognitive architecture family
description: Family of unified theories of cognition modeled as computational architectures: ACT-R (Anderson 1993) -> SOAR (Newell 1990) -> CLARION (Sun 2002) -> Substrate (2026 us-or-substrate compliant). Each proposes integrated framework for memory + reasoning + learning.

name: Free probability + Random matrix theory family
description: Family of non-classical probability theories for matrix-valued random variables: Voiculescu (1985) free probability + Marchenko-Pastur (1967) bulk distribution + Tracy-Widom (1994) edge distribution + Dyson (1962) ensembles. Substrate Layer 2 spectral observability uses this lineage.

name: Sparse distributed memory family
description: Family of high-dimensional sparse memory architectures: Kanerva SDM (1988) -> Frady-Sommer SDM (2020) -> SBDR (Rachkovskij). Common pattern: address-content paired binding with sparse representations + cleanup retrieval.

name: Complementary Learning Systems family
description: Dual-memory architecture lineage: McClelland-McNaughton-O'Reilly 1995 -> Kumaran-Hassabis-McClelland 2016 update. Hippocampus fast pattern-separation episodic + neocortex slow generalization semantic. Substrate v3.2 multi-substrate wrapper uses this lineage.

name: Discriminative learning family
description: Family of discriminative classifiers: perceptron (Rosenblatt 1958) -> logistic regression -> SVM (Vapnik 1992) -> structured perceptron (Collins 2002) -> CRF (Lafferty 2001) -> substrate discriminative perceptron + Tier-2 schema. Substrate universal lever per Findings 12 92pct.

name: HMM sequence labeling family
description: Family of probabilistic sequence labeling: HMM Baum-Welch (1966) -> Viterbi decoding (1967) -> CRF (Lafferty 2001) -> substrate-classical NL stack (POS / slot-filling / NER). Foundation for substrate-classical NL pipeline at substrate-product Tier-A.

name: Biological learning rules family
description: Family of biologically-grounded synaptic plasticity rules: Hebbian (1949 'cells that fire together wire together') -> BCM rule (1982) -> STDP (Markram 1997) -> dopaminergic RPE (Schultz 1997). Substrate has BCM atom; remaining substrate extensions candidate.

name: Spectral observability family
description: Family of spectral methods for representation analysis: SVD (Stewart 1993) -> PCA (Pearson 1901) -> RMT (Wigner 1955) -> substrate Layer 2 spectral observability (2026). Substrate-novel methodology: substrate measures own codebook structure via RMT.

name: Categorical / compositional NLP family
description: Family of categorical / compositional NL frameworks: DisCoCat (Coecke-Sadrzadeh-Clark 2010) + functor-based semantics + tensor product semantics. Substrate v4.0 lineage triangle includes DisCoCat alongside FHRR + GHRR.

name: Dual-process recognition memory family
description: Family of recognition memory theories: Mandler dual-process (1980) hippocampal recollection + cortical familiarity. Foundation for substrate Option B+H combined per Drill 1 ranking (file_id recollection + top-k retrieval familiarity).
